purpose: SP15 stage 2 (Q2 for the E upstroke, graded): hold the function (B3 genome and flags), change the input by a graded amount that keeps the response observable. The dendritic and apical membrane area (cm, g_pas and the distributed Ih density together) is scaled 1.5, 2 and 3 times at fixed geometry. Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-12-h01-topographic-strategy.md (stage 2 addendum).
executor_note: Runs on the Vast.ai box (NEURON 9.0.2) from a clean worktree of this branch; the main box checkout carries another session's edits.
image: braintrace-h01-neuron:9.0.2 (reference image; not used by the local executor)
holdout: Sweep 54 (330 pA) is sealed and is not an input. Only sweep 56 (200 pA) is used; the upstroke is read from spike 1.
evaluation: One dose at sweep 56 = one evaluation; three doses = three evaluations.

base_candidate.note: The stage-1 control: B3 flags at nseg factor 1 without soma-current probes. Its run q2-nseg1-sweep56 is the x1 point of this series (653.3 V/s, count 4, first spike 126.5 ms, threshold -57.4 mV) and is not rerun.

2.title: Stage 2: dendritic and apical membrane area x1.5, x2 and x3 at sweep 56, nseg factor 1
2.prediction: If the upstroke lives in the function (somatic sodium), the spike-1 maximum rise stays within max(3 x the mesh deviation, 10 percent) of the x1 control, that is within 166 V/s of 653 V/s, at every dose that still spikes. If it lives in the input (cable load), the maximum rise falls monotonically with the dose and leaves that band before the cell stops spiking. Reported, not banded: the 200 pA count, the first-spike time, the threshold, the post-spike level and the onset capacitance at each dose.
2.rejection: Every dose that leaves the band also fails to spike (no reading, as in stage 1), or the maximum rise moves without a monotone trend across the three doses (the dose is not acting through the cable load).
2.unchanged: All B3 flags of q2-nseg1.candidate.json; nseg factor 1; CVode 1e-10; recorded command plus bias; stop 2100 ms; no soma-current probes; the geometry, the axial resistance and every soma mechanism.
